title: Escapewheel source resolution document
description: Shape of sources.json. Maps a source name declared by an external resource entry to where that body of data is, for one reader in one situation. It is not a packet resource, so packet immutability does not reach it; a location can be corrected when a mirror moves.

$schema.description: This document's meta-schema, by $id. Identity rather than a fetch instruction: a reader MUST NOT dereference it and MUST NOT require it.

sources_standard_version.description: Which version of this document format is in use, so a reader refuses a future one rather than misreading it.

description.description: Human context: whose mirror this is, and for whom. Read by nothing.

sources.description: Source name to where that source is. A name is opaque to this specification and matches the `source` field of an external resource entry.

uri.description: Where this source is: an absolute URI, or an absolute filesystem path for data staged locally. A resource's own `uri` is a path relative to this.

description.description: Human context for this one source. Read by nothing.
